Airhypo Cyberfinger.name: Airhypo Cyberfinger
Airhypo Cyberfinger.description:
Cyberfinger that conceals an @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.Th74cfC87RqEJKAb]{Airhypo}.

Can only be installed on a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_cyberware.Item.f9u0uhwRBcunP0gz]{Modular Finger Cyberhand}.

Ballpoint Cyberfinger.name: Ballpoint Cyberfinger
Ballpoint Cyberfinger.description:
Cyberfinger that conceals a ballpoint pen.

Can only be installed on a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_cyberware.Item.f9u0uhwRBcunP0gz]{Modular Finger Cyberhand}.

Budget Chipware Socket.name: Budget Chipware Socket
Budget Chipware Socket.description: A cheap socket for a single installation of chipware. Damage to the head sends the installed chipware 30 m/yds away, potentially breaking it.

Bullet Storage Cyberfinger.name: Bullet Storage Cyberfinger
Bullet Storage Cyberfinger.description:
Cyberfinger that conceals two bullets of any type.

Can only be installed on a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_cyberware.Item.f9u0uhwRBcunP0gz]{Modular Finger Cyberhand}.

Dartgun Cyberfinger.name: Dartgun Cyberfinger
Dartgun Cyberfinger.description:
Cyberfinger that conceals a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_weapons.Item.fSvkIl83Rsqd7O16]{Dartgun}.

Can only be installed on a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_cyberware.Item.f9u0uhwRBcunP0gz]{Modular Finger Cyberhand}.

Discount Cyberaudio Suite.name: Discount Cyberaudio Suite
Discount Cyberaudio Suite.description: A cheap and bulky interface for an audio enhancement.

Explicit Memory Stimulator.name: Explicit Memory Stimulator
Explicit Memory Stimulator.description:
Enhances memorization. +2 Concentration while installed.

Chipware must be installed into a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.IJarQGKk5rPayoLT]{Chipware Socket} or similar device.

Flashbulb.name: Flashbulb
Flashbulb.description: As an action, anyone within 25m/yds that can see the Flashbulb must make a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.will+@skills.resistTortureOrDrugs #DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs]]{DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs} or suffer the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_critical-injuries-head.Item.qoegLCfpEOQifeZq]{Damaged Eye} critical injury for 1 minute.

Flashlight Cyberfinger.name: Flashlight Cyberfinger
Flashlight Cyberfinger.description:
Cyberfinger that conceals a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.spgehgLv94vrH4Zo]{Flashlight}.

Can only be installed on a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_cyberware.Item.f9u0uhwRBcunP0gz]{Modular Finger Cyberhand}.

Hardened Shielding (Borgware).name: Hardened Shielding (Borgware)
Hardened Shielding (Borgware).description: Install into a piece of Borgware to make it resistant to EMP effects.

Hardened Shielding (Cybereye).name: Hardened Shielding (Cybereye)
Hardened Shielding (Cybereye).description: The eye and installed options are not affected by EMP effects.

Hardened Shielding (Internal).name: Hardened Shielding (Internal)
Hardened Shielding (Internal).description: All internal cyberware is not affected by EMP effects.

Heuristic Health Monitor.name: Heuristic Health Monitor
Heuristic Health Monitor.description: Requires @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.0d2bEozOFhfPgkUP]{Biomonitor}. Can know HP at a glance.

Homing Tracer Cyberfinger.name: Homing Tracer Cyberfinger
Homing Tracer Cyberfinger.description:
Cyberfinger that silently points the way to a paired @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.IqXTqNGBmSuigIWv]{Tracer Button}.

Can only be installed on a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_cyberware.Item.f9u0uhwRBcunP0gz]{Modular Finger Cyberhand}.

Implanted Fūma Kotarō Linear Frame H.name: Implanted Fūma Kotarō Linear Frame H
Implanted Fūma Kotarō Linear Frame H.description:
Increases your BODY stat to 12 and Stealth +2. Drawing and sheathing the frame's weapons does not require an Action and can be concealed without a check.

An Internal Linear Frame can be identified with a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.tech+@skills.cybertech #DV13 Cybertech]]{DV13 Cybertech} check.

Requires @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.Lx9FSNDEIxLZ7Pyh]{Grafted Muscle and Bone Lace} x2 (Installed Separately) & BODY 8

Implanted Fūma Kotarō Linear Frame VH.name: Implanted Fūma Kotarō Linear Frame VH
Implanted Fūma Kotarō Linear Frame VH.description:
Increases your BODY stat to 12 and Stealth +2. Drawing and sheathing the frame's weapons does not require an Action and can be concealed without a check.

An Internal Linear Frame can be identified with a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.tech+@skills.cybertech #DV13 Cybertech]]{DV13 Cybertech} check.

Requires @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.Lx9FSNDEIxLZ7Pyh]{Grafted Muscle and Bone Lace} x2 (Installed Separately) & BODY 8

Implanted LF-001 SWAT Linear Frame.name: Implanted LF-001 SWAT Linear Frame
Implanted LF-001 SWAT Linear Frame.description:
Increases your BODY stat to 12 and ignores the normal movement penalty for climbing and swimming

An Internal Linear Frame can be identified with a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.tech+@skills.cybertech #DV13 Cybertech]]{DV13 Cybertech} check.

Requires @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.Lx9FSNDEIxLZ7Pyh]{Grafted Muscle and Bone Lace} x2 (Installed Separately) & BODY 8

Implanted Vermilion Linear Frame.name: Implanted Vermilion Linear Frame
Implanted Vermilion Linear Frame.description:
Increases your BODY stat to 12 and enhance running speed. No penalty for jumping.

An Internal Linear Frame can be identified with a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.tech+@skills.cybertech #DV13 Cybertech]]{DV13 Cybertech} check.

Requires @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.Lx9FSNDEIxLZ7Pyh]{Grafted Muscle and Bone Lace} x2 (Installed Separately) & BODY 8

Integrated Cyberdeck Upgrade.name: Integrated Cyberdeck Upgrade
Integrated Cyberdeck Upgrade.description:
Requires @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.eZg3gGGEJ7r2K9ng]{Cyberdeck (Hardwired)}

Adds an extra slot to the cyberdeck — Not currently supported requires manual update.

Laser Pointer Cyberfinger.name: Laser Pointer Cyberfinger
Laser Pointer Cyberfinger.description:
Cyberfinger that conceals a Laser Pointer.

Can only be installed on a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_cyberware.Item.f9u0uhwRBcunP0gz]{Modular Finger Cyberhand}.

Lighter Cyberfinger.name: Lighter Cyberfinger
Lighter Cyberfinger.description:
Cyberfinger that conceals a lighter.

Can only be installed on a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_cyberware.Item.f9u0uhwRBcunP0gz]{Modular Finger Cyberhand}.

Lockpick Cyberfinger.name: Lockpick Cyberfinger
Lockpick Cyberfinger.description:
Cyberfinger that conceals a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.vlhGpguIMioeA8fe]{Lock Picking Set}.

Can only be installed on a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_cyberware.Item.f9u0uhwRBcunP0gz]{Modular Finger Cyberhand}.

Microphone Cyberfinger.name: Microphone Cyberfinger
Microphone Cyberfinger.description:
Cyberfinger that conceals an @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.Lo7rXsc5ToQf2KlN]{Audio Recorder}.

Can only be installed on a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_cyberware.Item.f9u0uhwRBcunP0gz]{Modular Finger Cyberhand}.

Mini Air Supply Cyberfinger.name: Mini Air Supply Cyberfinger
Mini Air Supply Cyberfinger.description:
Cyberfinger that conceals 10min of breathable air. Recharges in 1hr.

Can only be installed on a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_cyberware.Item.f9u0uhwRBcunP0gz]{Modular Finger Cyberhand}.

Modular Finger Cyberhand.name: Modular Finger Cyberhand
Modular Finger Cyberhand.description:
Comes with 5 standard cyberfingers.

Can be installed into your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.WzgaetvvHUQeD19B]{Meat Arm} as the only piece of cyberware.

Neo-Soviet Cyberarm.name: Neo-Soviet Cyberarm
Neo-Soviet Cyberarm.description:
A soviet cybernetical replacement arm. Comes with a free hand pre-installed.

This arm imposes a -1 penalty to rolls for users without BODY 8+

One Shot Special Cyberfinger.name: One Shot Special Cyberfinger
One Shot Special Cyberfinger.description:
Cyberfinger that conceals a single shot Pistol.

Can only be installed on a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_cyberware.Item.f9u0uhwRBcunP0gz]{Modular Finger Cyberhand}.

Popup Net Launcher.name: Popup Net Launcher
Popup Net Launcher.description:
A concealable exotic net launcher.

Can't hold anything with this hand while activated.

Popup Shotgun.name: Popup Shotgun
Popup Shotgun.description:
A concealable @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_weapons.Item.PJhu6eY766OegZBo]{shotgun}.

Can't hold anything with this hand while activated.

Incompatible with all upgrades except Smartgun Link.

RacerBracer.name: RacerBracer
RacerBracer.description: Grants immunity to the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_critical-injuries-head.Item.e5wyX6r4Tem6bNwQ]{Whiplash} critical injury.

Reflex Co-Processor.name: Reflex Co-Processor
Reflex Co-Processor.description:
Negates REF requirement to dodge bullets.

The system does not provide any automation for dodging bullets.

Reinforced Cyberarm Upgrade.name: Reinforced Cyberarm Upgrade
Reinforced Cyberarm Upgrade.description: Durable reinforcement for your limb that prevents the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_critical-injuries-body.Item.Y65igO9rtakP4qSs]{Broken Arm} critical injury.

Reinforced Cyberleg Upgrade.name: Reinforced Cyberleg Upgrade
Reinforced Cyberleg Upgrade.description: Durable reinforcement for your limb that prevents the @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_critical-injuries-body.Item.yBy9rlhgZeaWGtHh]{Broken Leg} critical injury.

Sponsored Cybereye.name: Sponsored Cybereye
Sponsored Cybereye.description: A replacement eye with an ad-supported Chyron.

Spray Paint Cyberfinger.name: Spray Paint Cyberfinger
Spray Paint Cyberfinger.description:
Cyberfinger that conceals a small can of @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.3HWLPHE0VHMGgv48]{Glow Paint}.

Can only be installed on a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_cyberware.Item.f9u0uhwRBcunP0gz]{Modular Finger Cyberhand}.

Squirt Cyberfinger.name: Squirt Cyberfinger
Squirt Cyberfinger.description:
Cyberfinger that conceals and sprays various non-corrosive liquids.

Can only be installed on a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_cyberware.Item.f9u0uhwRBcunP0gz]{Modular Finger Cyberhand}.

Standard Cyberfinger.name: Standard Cyberfinger
Standard Cyberfinger.description: A finger for your @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_cyberware.Item.f9u0uhwRBcunP0gz]{Modular Finger Cyberhand}

Trauma Response Nanomatrix.name: Trauma Response Nanomatrix
Trauma Response Nanomatrix.description: Can fully repair @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.micrAI9oicghVbcG]{Skinweave} or @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.O5GmxTYCrrs8uWAd]{Subdermal Armor} once a day.

Wirecutter/Scissors Cyberfingers.name: Wirecutter/Scissors Cyberfingers
Wirecutter/Scissors Cyberfingers.description:
A pair of cyberfinger that conceal retractable scissor blades tough enough to cut small wires.

Can only be installed on a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_cyberware.Item.f9u0uhwRBcunP0gz]{Modular Finger Cyberhand}.

Function as a Poor Quality weapon.
